cohort: 110 children aged 6-60 months admitted to Al-Khansaa Teaching Hospital, Iraq, between December 2020 and June 2021, with 55 children with a first febrile seizure (case group) and 55 children with febrile illness but no seizure (control group).
finding: Low birth weight, formula milk feeding, positive family history of febrile seizure, anemia, caesarean section, and passive smoking during pregnancy were associated with an increased risk of first febrile seizure.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of first febrile seizure.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with increased risk of febrile seizure
